en: A black-and-white illustrated postcard showing a puppet theater stage labeled 'Europäisches Kasperletheater'. The stage is populated by several puppets, including a large central figure wielding a huge mallet and another with a rifle. The puppets are depicted in exaggerated, caricatured styles, with some hanging over the edge of the stage. An audience of people is shown watching the performance. Two small flags are visible on top of the theater, and there are trees in the background. The text at the top reads 'Ha! Er röchelt noch!'
